findings.title: CTA in normal flow may trade horizontal off-canvas overflow for vertical overflow or golden spacing drift (unverified)
findings.evidence: The diff removes position:absolute, left:9999px, and top:24px from `.pricing-card__cta` without adding compensating spacing rules. The card height, gap, and overflow rules and the card markup are not present in the available hunk, so the flow-height effect is unmeasured.
findings.counterexample: Render the candidate at 460x460 and measure stage.scrollHeight versus stage.clientHeight after the CTA enters flow, and compare the CTA offsetTop/offsetLeft against the golden. If scrollHeight exceeds clientHeight, or the CTA shifts relative to the golden by the removed 24px offset, the no-scrollbar and visual-golden requirements fail despite the deletion.
findings.requirement: The 460x460 stage must render without scrollbars and must match the visual golden.
findings.verification: Capture the 460x460 render with scrollWidth/scrollHeight measurements and a golden diff; this hypothesis is unproven until those artifacts exist.
